problems.reason: Sentences 13 and 14 give conflicting age ranges and stages for Rinconsaurus: 13 places it in the Campanian (≈83 Ma) while 14 places it in the Santonian (≈85.7–83.6 Ma), which are successive but distinct stages.
Both sentences state that in 2007 researchers assigned Rinconsaurus to a clade/tribe within Aeolosauridae/Saltasaurinae, repeating the same classification information.
Sentences 10 and 11 both describe the proposal of a clade called Rinconsauria for Rinconsaurus and Muyelensaurus, repeating the same claim.
